article.title: The culture that is Texas high school football
article.excerpt: After Texas high school builds $60-million stadium, rival district plans one for nearly $70 million Need I say more? I will nonetheless: In Frisco, which neighbors Allen and McKinney, the district will pay $30 million over several years to use the Dallas Cowboys’ new 12,000-seat practice field for high school football and soccer games, as well as graduation
